scientific_conclusion: Aggregating objects before the log ratio removes outright sign conflict: all four population-fold gradient cosines are positive. This confirms that individual-cube cosmic variance was a material confounder in V65 and V66.
The frozen coherence threshold is nevertheless missed, with median fold cosine 0.489 and two weak folds. A population objective is not yet train-split stable.

The larger failure is estimator convergence: rank8 and sealed rank16 full-population log ratios differ by as much as 0.946, and fold values differ from the full value by as much as 1.340. The finite-rank pair estimator is too noisy to serve as a training objective.
No pair-objective refit is authorized. The estimator's Monte Carlo convergence must be established independently of any model update before pair-loss design resumes.

selected_next_step.action: freeze and run a no-refit train-only population pair-estimator rank-convergence audit
